newsitem.title: CHINA: China 1996 tourism revenues seen up 15 percent.
newsitem.headline: China 1996 tourism revenues seen up 15 percent.

text.p: China's tourism industry is expected to earn a record $10 billion in foreign exchange in 1996, up 15 percent from 1995, the Xinhua news agency said on Sunday.

The number of trips to China by foreign tourists were expected to increase by more than 10 percent in 1996, Xinhua said, quoting the China National Tourism Administration. Foreign tourists made 46.4 million trips to China in 1995.
China hoped to attract 49 million tourists and generate $10.5 billion in foreign exchange revenues in 1997, newspapers have said.
